title: Legitimate Interest Assessment (LIA) Sidecar Schema
description: Canonical lia-sidecar.json state for the legitimate-interest skill. schema_version ('1.0') is a data-format version, independent of the skill's own version (recorded only in SKILL.md frontmatter, never duplicated here). The shape mirrors SKILL.md's EDPB three-step test (step1 pursuit of a legitimate interest, step2 necessity, step3 balancing) plus an overall verdict and a domain-specific gaps[] register of unresolved balancing factors (evidence-and-effectiveness-style honest gaps, never silently closed). validation.findings[] is the deterministic validator's OWN diagnostics about this document (gate vocabulary rejection|warning|info) — a distinct axis from gaps[], which records open questions about the assessment's substance, not about this document's structural conformance.

schema_version.description: Data-format version of this sidecar schema. Independent of the legitimate-interest skill's own version (metadata.version in SKILL.md).

generated_by.description: Producer identifier, typically 'legitimate-interest skill v<X.Y>' (the skill's own live version, not this schema's).

assessment.description: The processing activity this LIA assesses (SKILL.md 'Batch 1: Essential Questions').

id.description: Stable within-skill identifier, if the surrounding session has one (e.g. an external RoPA activity ref).

label.description: Short human label for the assessed processing activity.

step1.description: STEP 1: Pursuit of a Legitimate Interest (SKILL.md).

step2.description: STEP 2: Necessity of the Processing (SKILL.md). Absent/no verdict when step1 failed and the assessment correctly short-circuited.

step3.description: STEP 3: Balancing Test (SKILL.md). Absent/no verdict when step1 or step2 failed and the assessment correctly short-circuited.

balance.description: Which way the balance tips before any mitigating measures.

overall.description: Overall LIA outcome (SKILL.md 'OVERALL RESULT'). The three-step test is conjunctive: li_appropriate can only be 'yes'/'conditional' when every reached step's verdict is not 'fail'.

gaps.description: Unresolved balancing factors — an honestly-recorded open question about the assessment's substance, never silently converted into a negative finding nor invented to close it (mirrors evidence-and-effectiveness.md's Unknown discipline in toms-art32). Distinct from validation.findings[], which is about this document's own structural conformance.

severity.description: Optional: how much this open question should weigh on the overall verdict. 'rejection' marks a gap that blocks treating li_appropriate as final.

handoff_context.description: Optional signal for the inbound handoff from data-subject-rights (SKILL.md 'Right to Object Response Mode' / data-subject-rights.md's Art. 21(1) compelling-grounds re-assessment).

objection_pending.description: True when this run assesses (or could support) an Art. 21(1) objection's compelling-legitimate-grounds re-balancing.

validation.description: Deterministic structural validation only — never a substantive appropriateness score. validation.findings[].severity is the deterministic validator's own GATE vocabulary (rejection/warning/info), not a legal risk judgement.
